integrity: Finite computation is backed by the unique-Hamiltonian-cycle enumeration argument and two separate exact enumerators; the all-order family uses an explicit shell and automorphism proof.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustive isomorphism census only for bipartite biconnected outerplanar graphs with up to twelve vertices.
For larger graphs only the explicit two-chord family is classified, not all examples.
A specialized earlier priority result may exist; no independent literature or scientific audit has been performed.
title: Sharp orbit-refinement obstruction for bipartite biconnected outerplanar graphs
